verses.original: וֶאֱלִישָׁע֙ הַנָּבִ֔יא קָרָ֕א לְאַחַ֖ד מִבְּנֵ֣י הַנְּבִיאִ֑ים וַיֹּ֨אמֶר ל֜וֹ חֲגֹ֣ר מָתְנֶ֗יךָ וְ֠קַח פַּ֣ךְ הַשֶּׁ֤מֶן הַזֶּה֙ בְּיָדֶ֔ךָ וְלֵ֖ךְ רָמֹ֥ת גִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: we·’ĕ·lî·šā‘ han·nā·ḇî qā·rā lə·’a·ḥaḏ mib·bə·nê han·nə·ḇî·’îm way·yō·mer lōw ḥă·ḡōr mā·ṯə·ne·ḵā wə·qaḥ paḵ haš·še·men haz·zeh bə·yā·ḏe·ḵā wə·lêḵ rā·mōṯ gil·‘āḏ
verses.literal: Now Elisha the prophet summoned one of the sons of the prophets and said to him Tuck your cloak under your belt take this flask of oil and go to Ramoth-gilead . . .
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO o profeta Eliseu chamou um dos filhos dos profetas, e lhe disse: Cinge os teus lombos; e toma este vaso de azeite na tua mão, e vai a Ramote de Gileade;

verses.original: וּבָ֖אתָ שָׁ֑מָּה וּרְאֵֽה־ שָׁ֠ם יֵה֨וּא בֶן־ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֜ט בֶּן־ נִמְשִׁ֗י וּבָ֙אתָ֙ וַהֲקֵֽמֹתוֹ֙ מִתּ֣וֹך אֶחָ֔יו וְהֵבֵיאתָ֥ אֹת֖וֹ חֶ֥דֶר בְּחָֽדֶר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·ṯā šām·māh ū·rə·’ê·hō·šā- šām yê·hū ḇen- yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ ben- nim·šî ū·ḇā·ṯā wa·hă·qê·mō·ṯōw mit·tōḵ ’e·ḥāw wə·hê·ḇê·ṯā ’ō·ṯōw ḥe·ḏer bə·ḥā·ḏer
verses.literal: When you arrive . . . look . . . for Jehu son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi Go in get him away from his companions and take him to an inner room . . .
verses.literalPt: E, chegando lá, vê onde está Jeú, filho de Jeosafá, filho de Ninsi; entra, e faze que ele se levante do meio de seus irmãos, e leva-o à câmara interior.

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֤ פַךְ־ הַשֶּׁ֙מֶן֙ וְיָצַקְתָּ֣ עַל־ רֹאשׁ֔וֹ וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה מְשַׁחְתִּ֥יךָֽ לְמֶ֖לֶךְ אֶל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּפָתַחְתָּ֥ הַדֶּ֛לֶת וְנַ֖סְתָּה וְלֹ֥א תְחַכֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ·tā p̄aḵ- haš·še·men wə·yā·ṣaq·tā ‘al- rō·šōw wə·’ā·mar·tā kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh mə·šaḥ·tî·ḵā lə·me·leḵ ’el- yiś·rā·’êl ū·p̄ā·ṯaḥ·tā had·de·leṯ wə·nas·tāh wə·lō ṯə·ḥak·keh
verses.literal: Then take the flask of oil pour it on his head and declare This is what the LORD says I anoint you king over Israel Then open the door and run Do not delay
verses.literalPt: E toma o vaso de azeite, e derrama-o sobre a sua cabeça, e dize: Assim diz o SENHOR: Ungi-te rei sobre Israel. Então abre a porta, foge, e não te detenhas.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֧לֶךְ הַנַּ֛עַר הַנַּ֥עַר הַנָּבִ֖יא רָמֹ֥ת גִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ han·na·‘ar han·na·‘ar han·nā·ḇî rā·mōṯ gil·‘āḏ
verses.literal: So the young . . . prophet went to Ramoth-gilead . . .
verses.literalPt: Foi, pois, o moço, o jovem profeta, a Ramote de Gileade.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֗א וְהִנֵּ֨ה שָׂרֵ֤י הַחַ֙יִל֙ יֹֽשְׁבִ֔ים וַיֹּ֕אמֶר דָּבָ֥ר לִ֛י אֵלֶ֖יךָ הַשָּׂ֑ר וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יֵהוּא֙ אֶל־ מִ֣י מִכֻּלָּ֔נוּ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלֶ֥יךָ הַשָּֽׂר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō wə·hin·nêh śā·rê ha·ḥa·yil yō·šə·ḇîm way·yō·mer dā·ḇār lî ’ê·le·ḵā haś·śār way·yō·mer yê·hū ’el- mî mik·kul·lā·nū way·yō·mer ’ê·le·ḵā haś·śār
verses.literal: and when he arrived the army commanders were sitting there I have a message for you commander he said For which of us asked Jehu For you commander he replied
verses.literalPt: E, entrando ele, eis que os capitães do exército estavam assentados ali; e disse: Capitão, tenho uma palavra que te dizer. E disse Jeú: A qual de todos nós? E disse: A ti, capitão!

verses.original: וַיָּ֙קָם֙ וַיָּבֹ֣א הַבַּ֔יְתָה וַיִּצֹ֥ק הַשֶּׁ֖מֶן אֶל־ רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מְשַׁחְתִּ֧יךָֽ לְמֶ֛לֶךְ אֶל־ עַ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām way·yā·ḇō hab·bay·ṯāh way·yi·ṣōq haš·še·men ’el- rō·šōw way·yō·mer lōw kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl mə·šaḥ·tî·ḵā lə·me·leḵ ’el- ‘am Yah·weh ’el- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: So Jehu got up and went into the house where the young prophet poured the oil on his head and declared This is what the LORD the God of Israel says I anoint you king over the LORD’s . . . people Israel
verses.literalPt: Então se levantou, entrou na casa, e derramou o azeite sobre a sua cabeça, e disse: Assim diz o SENHOR Deus de Israel: Ungi-te rei sobre o povo do SENHOR, sobre Israel.

verses.original: וְהִ֨כִּיתָ֔ה אֶת־ בֵּ֥ית אַחְאָ֖ב אֲדֹנֶ֑יךָ וְנִקַּמְתִּ֞י דְּמֵ֣י׀ עֲבָדַ֣י הַנְּבִיאִ֗ים וּדְמֵ֛י כָּל־ עַבְדֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מִיַּ֥ד אִיזָֽבֶל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hik·kî·ṯāh ’eṯ- bêṯ ’aḥ·’āḇ ’ă·ḏō·ne·ḵā wə·niq·qam·tî də·mê ‘ă·ḇā·ḏay han·nə·ḇî·’îm ū·ḏə·mê kāl- ‘aḇ·ḏê Yah·weh mî·yaḏ ’î·zā·ḇel
verses.literal: And you are to strike down the house of your master Ahab so that I may avenge the blood of My servants the prophets and the blood of all the servants of the LORD shed by the hand of Jezebel
verses.literalPt: E ferirás a casa de Acabe, teu senhor, para que eu vingue o sangue de meus servos, os profetas, e o sangue de todos os servos do SENHOR, da mão de Jezabel.

verses.original: וְאָבַ֖ד כָּל־ בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב וְהִכְרַתִּ֤י לְאַחְאָב֙ מַשְׁתִּ֣ין בְּקִ֔יר וְעָצ֥וּר וְעָז֖וּב בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·ḇaḏ kāl- bêṯ ’aḥ·’āḇ wə·hiḵ·rat·tî lə·’aḥ·’āḇ maš·tîn bə·qîr wə·‘ā·ṣūr wə·‘ā·zūḇ bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: The whole house of Ahab will perish and I will cut off from Ahab every male . . . both slave and free in Israel
verses.literalPt: E toda a casa de Acabe perecerá; destruirei de Acabe todo o homem, tanto o encerrado como o absolvido em Israel.

verses.original: וְנָֽתַתִּי֙ אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֔ב כְּבֵ֖ית יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ נְבָ֑ט וּכְבֵ֖ית בַּעְשָׁ֥א בֶן־ אֲחִיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- bêṯ ’aḥ·’āḇ kə·ḇêṯ yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ben- nə·ḇāṭ ū·ḵə·ḇêṯ ba‘·šā ḇen- ’ă·ḥî·yāh
verses.literal: I will make the house of Ahab like the houses of Jeroboam son of Nebat and Baasha son of Ahijah
verses.literalPt: Porque à casa de Acabe hei de fazer como à casa de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, e como à casa de Baasa, filho de Aías.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ אִיזֶ֜בֶל יֹאכְל֧וּ הַכְּלָבִ֛ים בְּחֵ֥לֶק יִזְרְעֶ֖אל וְאֵ֣ין קֹבֵ֑ר וַיִּפְתַּ֥ח הַדֶּ֖לֶת וַיָּנֹֽס׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ’î·ze·ḇel yō·ḵə·lū hak·kə·lā·ḇîm bə·ḥê·leq yiz·rə·‘el wə·’ên qō·ḇêr way·yip̄·taḥ had·de·leṯ way·yā·nōs
verses.literal: And on the plot of ground at Jezreel the dogs will devour Jezebel and there will be no one to bury her Then the young prophet opened the door and ran
verses.literalPt: E os cães comerão a Jezabel no pedaço de campo de Jizreel; não haverá quem a enterre. Então abriu a porta e fugiu.

verses.original: וְיֵה֗וּא יָצָא֙ אֶל־ עַבְדֵ֣י אֲדֹנָ֔יו וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ הֲשָׁל֔וֹם מַדּ֛וּעַ בָּֽא־ הַמְשֻׁגָּ֥ע הַזֶּ֖ה אֵלֶ֑יךָ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אַתֶּ֛ם יְדַעְתֶּ֥ם אֶת־ הָאִ֖ישׁ וְאֶת־ שִׂיחֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yê·hū yā·ṣā ’el- ‘aḇ·ḏê ’ă·ḏō·nāw way·yō·mer lōw hă·šā·lō·wm mad·dū·a‘ bā- ham·šug·gā‘ haz·zeh ’ê·le·ḵā way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem ’at·tem yə·ḏa‘·tem ’eṯ- hā·’îš wə·’eṯ- śî·ḥōw
verses.literal: When Jehu went out to the servants of his master they asked Is everything all right Why did this madman come to you You know his kind and their babble he replied . . .
verses.literalPt: E, saindo Jeú aos servos de seu SENHOR, disseram-lhe: Vai tudo bem? Por que veio a ti este louco? E ele lhes disse: Bem conheceis o homem e o seu falar.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ שֶׁ֔קֶר הַגֶּד־ נָ֖א לָ֑נוּ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר כָּזֹ֤את וְכָזֹאת֙ אָמַ֤ר אֵלַי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה מְשַׁחְתִּ֥יךָֽ לְמֶ֖לֶךְ אֶל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū še·qer hag·geḏ- nā lā·nū way·yō·mer kā·zōṯ wə·ḵā·zōṯ ’ā·mar ’ê·lay lê·mōr kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh mə·šaḥ·tî·ḵā lə·me·leḵ ’el- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: That is a lie they said Tell us now So Jehu answered He talked to me about this and that saying This is what the LORD says I anoint you king over Israel
verses.literalPt: Mas eles disseram: É mentira; agora faze-nos saber. E disse: Assim e assim me falou, a saber: Assim diz o SENHOR: Ungi-te rei sobre Israel.

verses.original: וַֽיְמַהֲר֗וּ וַיִּקְחוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ בִּגְד֔וֹ וַיָּשִׂ֥ימוּ תַחְתָּ֖יו אֶל־ גֶּ֣רֶם הַֽמַּעֲל֑וֹת וַֽיִּתְקְעוּ֙ בַּשּׁוֹפָ֔ר וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ מָלַ֥ךְ יֵהֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: way·ma·hă·rū way·yiq·ḥū ’îš biḡ·ḏōw way·yā·śî·mū ṯaḥ·tāw ’el- ge·rem ham·ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ way·yiṯ·qə·‘ū baš·šō·w·p̄ār way·yō·mə·rū mā·laḵ yê·hū
verses.literal: Quickly each man took his garment and put it under Jehu on the bare steps Then they blew the ram’s horn and proclaimed Jehu is king
verses.literalPt: Então se apressaram, tomando cada um a sua roupa puseram debaixo dele, no mais alto degrau; e tocaram a buzina e disseram: Jeú reina!

verses.original: וַיִּתְקַשֵּׁ֗ר יֵה֛וּא בֶּן־ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בֶּן־ נִמְשִׁ֖י אֶל־ יוֹרָ֑ם וְיוֹרָם֩ הָיָ֨ה שֹׁמֵ֜ר בְּרָמֹ֣ת גִּלְעָ֗ד ה֚וּא וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִפְּנֵ֥י חֲזָאֵ֖ל מֶֽלֶךְ־ אֲרָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·qaš·šêr yê·hū ben- yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ ben- nim·šî ’el- yō·w·rām wə·yō·w·rām hā·yāh šō·mêr bə·rā·mōṯ gil·‘āḏ hū wə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl mip·pə·nê ḥă·zā·’êl me·leḵ- ’ă·rām
verses.literal: Thus Jehu son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram Now Joram and all Israel had been defending Ramoth-gilead . . . against Hazael king of Aram
verses.literalPt: Assim Jeú, filho de Jeosafá, filho de Ninsi, conspirou contra Jorão. Tinha, porém, Jorão cercado a Ramote de Gileade, ele e todo o Israel, por causa de Hazael, rei da Síria.

verses.original: וַיָּשָׁב֩ יְהוֹרָ֨ם הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ לְהִתְרַפֵּ֣א בִיְזְרְעֶ֗אל מִן־ הַמַּכִּים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַכֻּ֣הוּ אֲרַמִּ֔ים בְּהִלָּ֣חֲמ֔וֹ אֶת־ חֲזָאֵ֖ל מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֑ם וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יֵהוּא֙ אִם־ יֵ֣שׁ נַפְשְׁכֶ֔ם אַל־ יֵצֵ֤א פָלִיט֙ מִן־ הָעִ֔יר לָלֶ֖כֶת לַגִּיד בְּיִזְרְעֶֽאל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šāḇ yə·hō·w·rām ham·me·leḵ lə·hiṯ·rap·pê ḇiy·zə·rə·‘el min- ham·mak·kîm ’ă·šer yak·ku·hū ’ă·ram·mîm bə·hil·lā·ḥă·mōw ’eṯ- ḥă·zā·’êl me·leḵ ’ă·rām way·yō·mer yê·hū ’im- yêš nap̄·šə·ḵem ’al- yê·ṣê p̄ā·lîṭ min- hā·‘îr lā·le·ḵeṯ lag·gīḏ bə·yiz·rə·‘el
verses.literal: but King Joram had returned to Jezreel to recover from the wounds he had suffered at the hands of the Arameans in the battle against Hazael their king . . . So Jehu said If . . . you commanders wish to make me king then do not let anyone escape from the city to go and tell it in Jezreel
verses.literalPt: Porém o rei Jorão voltou para se curar em Jizreel das feridas que os sírios lhe fizeram, quando pelejou contra Hazael, rei da Síria. E disse Jeú: Se é da vossa vontade, ninguém saia da cidade, nem escape, para ir denunciar isto em Jizreel.

verses.original: וַיִּרְכַּ֤ב יֵהוּא֙ וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ יִזְרְעֶ֔אלָה כִּ֥י יוֹרָ֖ם שֹׁכֵ֣ב שָׁ֑מָּה וַֽאֲחַזְיָה֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה יָרַ֖ד לִרְא֥וֹת אֶת־ יוֹרָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·kaḇ yê·hū way·yê·leḵ yiz·rə·‘e·lāh kî yō·w·rām šō·ḵêḇ šām·māh wa·’ă·ḥaz·yāh me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh yā·raḏ lir·’ō·wṯ ’eṯ- yō·w·rām
verses.literal: Then Jehu got into his chariot and went to Jezreel because Joram was laid up there And Ahaziah king of Judah had gone down to see him
verses.literalPt: Então Jeú subiu a um carro, e foi a Jizreel, porque Jorão estava deitado ali; e também Acazias, rei de Judá, descera para ver a Jorão.

verses.original: וְהַצֹּפֶה֩ עֹמֵ֨ד עַֽל־ הַמִּגְדָּ֜ל בְּיִזְרְעֶ֗אל וַיַּ֞רְא אֶת־ שִׁפְעַ֤ת יֵהוּא֙ בְּבֹא֔וֹ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר שִׁפְעַ֖ת אֲנִ֣י רֹאֶ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוֹרָ֗ם קַ֥ח רַכָּ֛ב וּֽשְׁלַ֥ח לִקְרָאתָ֖ם וְיֹאמַ֥ר הֲשָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haṣ·ṣō·p̄eh ‘ō·mêḏ ‘al- ham·miḡ·dāl bə·yiz·rə·‘el way·yar ’eṯ- šip̄·‘aṯ yê·hū bə·ḇō·’ōw way·yō·mer šip̄·‘aṯ ’ă·nî rō·’eh way·yō·mer yə·hō·w·rām qaḥ rak·kāḇ ū·šə·laḥ liq·rā·ṯām wə·yō·mar hă·šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: Now the watchman standing on the tower in Jezreel saw Jehu’s troops approaching and he called out I see a company of troops Choose a rider Joram commanded Send him out to meet them and ask Have you come in peace
verses.literalPt: E o atalaia estava na torre de Jizreel, e viu a tropa de Jeú, que vinha, e disse: Vejo uma tropa. Então disse Jorão: Toma um cavaleiro, e envia-lho ao encontro; e diga: Há paz?

verses.original: וַיֵּלֶךְ֩ רֹכֵ֨ב הַסּ֜וּס לִקְרָאת֗וֹ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ הֲשָׁל֔וֹם וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יֵה֛וּא מַה־ לְּךָ֥ וּלְשָׁל֖וֹם סֹ֣ב אֶֽל־ אַחֲרָ֑י וַיַּגֵּ֤ד הַצֹּפֶה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בָּֽא־ הַמַּלְאָ֥ךְ עַד־ הֵ֖ם וְלֹֽא־ שָֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ rō·ḵêḇ has·sūs liq·rā·ṯōw way·yō·mer kōh- ’ā·mar ham·me·leḵ hă·šā·lō·wm way·yō·mer yê·hū mah- lə·ḵā ū·lə·šā·lō·wm sōḇ ’el- ’a·ḥă·rāy way·yag·gêḏ haṣ·ṣō·p̄eh lê·mōr bā- ham·mal·’āḵ ‘aḏ- hêm wə·lō- šāḇ
verses.literal: So a horseman . . . rode off to meet Jehu and said This is what the king asks Have you come in peace What do you know about peace Jehu replied Fall in . . . behind me And the watchman . . . reported The messenger reached . . . them but he is not coming back
verses.literalPt: E o cavaleiro lhe foi ao encontro, e disse: Assim diz o rei: Há paz? E disse Jeú: Que tens tu que fazer com a paz? Passa-te para trás de mim. E o atalaia o fez saber, dizendo: Chegou a eles o mensageiro, porém não volta.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח רֹכֵ֣ב סוּס֮ שֵׁנִי֒ וַיָּבֹ֣א אֲלֵהֶ֔ם וַיֹּ֛אמֶר כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֥ר הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ שָׁל֑וֹם וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יֵה֛וּא מַה־ לְּךָ֥ וּלְשָׁל֖וֹם סֹ֥ב אֶֽל־ אַחֲרָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ rō·ḵêḇ sūs šê·nî way·yā·ḇō ’ă·lê·hem way·yō·mer kōh- ’ā·mar ham·me·leḵ šā·lō·wm way·yō·mer yê·hū mah- lə·ḵā ū·lə·šā·lō·wm sōḇ ’el- ’a·ḥă·rāy
verses.literal: So the king sent out a second horseman . . . who went to them and said This is what the king asks Have you come in peace What do you know about peace Jehu replied Fall in . . . behind me
verses.literalPt: Então enviou outro cavaleiro; e, chegando este a eles, disse: Assim diz o rei: Há paz? E disse Jeú: Que tens tu que fazer com a paz? Passa-te para trás de mim.

verses.original: וַיַּגֵּ֤ד הַצֹּפֶה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בָּ֥א עַד־ אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם וְלֹֽא־ שָׁ֑ב וְהַמִּנְהָ֗ג כְּמִנְהַג֙ יֵה֣וּא בֶן־ נִמְשִׁ֔י כִּ֥י בְשִׁגָּע֖וֹן יִנְהָֽג׃
verses.transliteration: way·yag·gêḏ haṣ·ṣō·p̄eh lê·mōr bā ‘aḏ- ’ă·lê·hem wə·lō- šāḇ wə·ham·min·hāḡ kə·min·haḡ yê·hū ḇen- nim·šî kî ḇə·šig·gā·‘ō·wn yin·hāḡ
verses.literal: Again the watchman . . . reported He reached . . . them but he is not coming back And the charioteer is driving like Jehu son of Nimshi . . . he is driving like a madman
verses.literalPt: E o atalaia o fez saber, dizendo: Também este chegou a eles, porém não volta; e o andar parece como o andar de Jeú, filho de Ninsi, porque anda furiosamente.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוֹרָם֙ אֱסֹ֔ר וַיֶּאְסֹ֖ר רִכְבּ֑וֹ וַיֵּצֵ֣א יְהוֹרָ֣ם מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל וַאֲחַזְיָ֨הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֜ה אִ֣ישׁ בְּרִכְבּ֗וֹ וַיֵּֽצְאוּ֙ לִקְרַ֣את יֵה֔וּא וַיִּמְצָאֻ֔הוּ בְּחֶלְקַ֖ת נָב֥וֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·hō·w·rām ’ĕ·sōr way·ye’·sōr riḵ·bōw way·yê·ṣê yə·hō·w·rām me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl wa·’ă·ḥaz·yā·hū me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh ’îš bə·riḵ·bōw way·yê·ṣə·’ū liq·raṯ yê·hū way·yim·ṣā·’u·hū bə·ḥel·qaṯ nā·ḇō·wṯ hay·yiz·rə·‘ê·lî
verses.literal: Harness Joram shouted and they harnessed his chariot Then Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah set out each in his own chariot and met . . . Jehu . . . on the property of Naboth the Jezreelite
verses.literalPt: Então disse Jorão: Aparelha o carro. E aparelharam o seu carro. E saiu Jorão, rei de Israel, e Acazias, rei de Judá, cada um em seu carro, e saíram ao encontro de Jeú, e o acharam no pedaço de campo de Nabote, o jizreelita.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כִּרְא֤וֹת יְהוֹרָם֙ אֶת־ יֵה֔וּא וַיֹּ֖אמֶר הֲשָׁל֣וֹם יֵה֑וּא וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ מָ֣ה הַשָּׁל֔וֹם עַד־ זְנוּנֵ֞י אִיזֶ֧בֶל אִמְּךָ֛ וּכְשָׁפֶ֖יהָ הָרַבִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kir·’ō·wṯ yə·hō·w·rām ’eṯ- yê·hū way·yō·mer hă·šā·lō·wm yê·hū way·yō·mer māh haš·šā·lō·wm ‘aḏ- zə·nū·nê ’î·ze·ḇel ’im·mə·ḵā ū·ḵə·šā·p̄e·hā hā·rab·bîm
verses.literal: When Joram saw Jehu he asked Have you come in peace Jehu How can there be peace he replied as long as the idolatry and witchcraft of your mother Jezebel abound
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, vendo Jorão a Jeú, disse: Há paz, Jeú? E disse ele: Que paz, enquanto as prostituições da tua mãe Jezabel e as suas feitiçarias são tantas?

verses.original: וַיַּהֲפֹ֧ךְ יְהוֹרָ֛ם יָדָ֖יו וַיָּנֹ֑ס וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֶל־ אֲחַזְיָ֖הוּ מִרְמָ֥ה אֲחַזְיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·hă·p̄ōḵ yə·hō·w·rām yā·ḏāw way·yā·nōs way·yō·mer ’el- ’ă·ḥaz·yā·hū mir·māh ’ă·ḥaz·yāh
verses.literal: Joram . . . turned around and fled calling out to Ahaziah Treachery Ahaziah
verses.literalPt: Então Jorão voltou as mãos e fugiu; e disse a Acazias: Traição há, Acazias.

verses.original: וְיֵה֞וּא מִלֵּ֧א יָד֣וֹ בַקֶּ֗שֶׁת וַיַּ֤ךְ אֶת־ יְהוֹרָם֙ בֵּ֣ין זְרֹעָ֔יו וַיֵּצֵ֥א הַחֵ֖צִי מִלִּבּ֑וֹ וַיִּכְרַ֖ע בְּרִכְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yê·hū mil·lê yā·ḏōw ḇaq·qe·šeṯ way·yaḵ ’eṯ- yə·hō·w·rām bên zə·rō·‘āw way·yê·ṣê ha·ḥê·ṣî mil·lib·bōw way·yiḵ·ra‘ bə·riḵ·bōw
verses.literal: Then Jehu drew . . . his bow and shot Joram between the shoulders The arrow pierced his heart and he slumped down in his chariot
verses.literalPt: Mas Jeú entesou o seu arco com toda a força, e feriu a Jorão entre os braços, e a flecha lhe saiu pelo coração; e ele caiu no seu carro.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אֶל־ בִּדְקַר֙ שְׁלֹשָׁה שָׂ֚א הַשְׁלִכֵ֔הוּ בְּחֶלְקַ֕ת שְׂדֵ֖ה נָב֣וֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִ֑י כִּֽי־ זְכֹ֞ר אֲנִ֣י וָאַ֗תָּה אֵ֣ת רֹכְבִ֤ים צְמָדִים֙ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אַחְאָ֣ב אָבִ֔יו וַֽיהוָה֙ נָשָׂ֣א עָלָ֔יו אֶת־ הַמַּשָּׂ֖א הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’el- biḏ·qar šə·lō·šå̄h śā haš·li·ḵê·hū bə·ḥel·qaṯ śə·ḏêh nā·ḇō·wṯ hay·yiz·rə·‘ê·lî kî- zə·ḵōr ’ă·nî wā·’at·tāh ’êṯ rō·ḵə·ḇîm ṣə·mā·ḏîm ’a·ḥă·rê ’aḥ·’āḇ ’ā·ḇîw Yah·weh nā·śā ‘ā·lāw ’eṯ- ham·maś·śā haz·zeh
verses.literal: And Jehu said to Bidkar his officer Pick him up and throw him into the field of Naboth the Jezreelite For remember that when you and I were riding together behind his father Ahab the LORD lifted up this burden against him
verses.literalPt: Então Jeú disse a Bidcar, seu capitão: Toma-o, lança-o no pedaço do campo de Nabote, o jizreelita; porque, lembra-te de que, indo eu e tu juntos a cavalo após seu pai, Acabe, o SENHOR pôs sobre ele esta sentença, dizendo:

verses.original: אִם־ לֹ֡א אֶת־ דְּמֵ֣י נָבוֹת֩ וְאֶת־ דְּמֵ֨י בָנָ֜יו רָאִ֤יתִי אֶ֙מֶשׁ֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְשִׁלַּמְתִּ֥י לְךָ֛ בַּחֶלְקָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה וְעַתָּ֗ה שָׂ֧א הַשְׁלִכֵ֛הוּ בַּחֶלְקָ֖ה כִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- lō ’eṯ- də·mê nā·ḇō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- də·mê ḇā·nāw rā·’î·ṯî ’e·meš nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·šil·lam·tî lə·ḵā ba·ḥel·qāh haz·zōṯ nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·‘at·tāh śā haš·li·ḵê·hū ba·ḥel·qāh kiḏ·ḇar Yah·weh
verses.literal: As surely . . . as I saw the blood of Naboth and the blood of his sons yesterday declares the LORD so will I repay you on this plot of ground declares the LORD Now then according to the word of the LORD pick him up and throw him on the plot of ground
verses.literalPt: Por certo vi ontem, à tarde, o sangue de Nabote e o sangue de seus filhos, diz o SENHOR; e neste mesmo campo te retribuirei, diz o SENHOR. Agora, pois, toma-o e lança-o neste campo, conforme a palavra do SENHOR.

verses.original: וַאֲחַזְיָ֤ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָה֙ רָאָ֔ה וַיָּ֕נָס דֶּ֖רֶךְ בֵּ֣ית הַגָּ֑ן וַיִּרְדֹּ֨ף אַחֲרָ֜יו יֵה֗וּא וַ֠יֹּאמֶר גַּם־ אֹת֞וֹ הַכֻּ֣הוּ אֶל־ הַמֶּרְכָּבָ֗ה בְּמַֽעֲלֵה־ גוּר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶֽת־ יִבְלְעָ֔ם וַיָּ֥נָס מְגִדּ֖וֹ וַיָּ֥מָת שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḥaz·yāh me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh rā·’āh way·yā·nās de·reḵ bêṯ hag·gān way·yir·dōp̄ ’a·ḥă·rāw yê·hū way·yō·mer gam- ’ō·ṯōw hak·ku·hū ’el- ham·mer·kā·ḇāh bə·ma·‘ă·lêh- ḡūr ’ă·šer ’eṯ- yiḇ·lə·‘ām way·yā·nās mə·ḡid·dōw way·yā·māṯ šām
verses.literal: When King Ahaziah of Judah saw this he fled up the road toward Beth-haggan And Jehu pursued him . . . shouting Shoot him too So they shot Ahaziah in his chariot on the Ascent of Gur - near Ibleam and he fled to Megiddo and died there
verses.literalPt: O que vendo Acazias, rei de Judá, fugiu pelo caminho da casa do jardim; porém Jeú o perseguiu dizendo: Feri também a este; e o feriram no carro à subida de Gur, que está junto a Ibleão. E fugiu a Megido, e morreu ali.

verses.original: וַיַּרְכִּ֧בוּ אֹת֛וֹ עֲבָדָ֖יו יְרוּשָׁלְָ֑מָה וַיִּקְבְּר֨וּ אֹת֧וֹ בִקְבֻרָת֛וֹ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֖יו בְּעִ֥יר דָּוִֽד׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yar·ki·ḇū ’ō·ṯōw ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw yə·rū·šā·lə·māh way·yiq·bə·rū ’ō·ṯōw ḇiq·ḇu·rā·ṯōw ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw bə·‘îr dā·wiḏ
verses.literal: Then his servants carried him by chariot to Jerusalem and buried him with his fathers in his tomb . . . in the City of David
verses.literalPt: E seus servos o levaram num carro a Jerusalém, e o sepultaram na sua sepultura junto a seus pais, na cidade de Davi

verses.original: וּבִשְׁנַת֙ אַחַ֣ת עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לְיוֹרָ֖ם בֶּן־ אַחְאָ֑ב מָלַ֥ךְ אֲחַזְיָ֖ה עַל־ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇiš·naṯ ’a·ḥaṯ ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh lə·yō·w·rām ben- ’aḥ·’āḇ mā·laḵ ’ă·ḥaz·yāh ‘al- yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: In the eleventh . . . . . . year of Joram son of Ahab Ahaziah had become king over Judah
verses.literalPt: (E no ano undécimo de Jorão, filho de Acabe, começou Acazias a reinar sobre Judá).

verses.original: וַיָּב֥וֹא יֵה֖וּא יִזְרְעֶ֑אלָה וְאִיזֶ֣בֶל שָׁמְעָ֗ה וַתָּ֨שֶׂם בַּפּ֤וּךְ עֵינֶ֙יהָ֙ וַתֵּ֣יטֶב אֶת־ רֹאשָׁ֔הּ וַתַּשְׁקֵ֖ף בְּעַ֥ד הַחַלּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·w yê·hū yiz·rə·‘e·lāh wə·’î·ze·ḇel šā·mə·‘āh wat·tā·śem bap·pūḵ ‘ê·ne·hā wat·tê·ṭeḇ ’eṯ- rō·šāh wat·taš·qêp̄ bə·‘aḏ ha·ḥal·lō·wn
verses.literal: Now when Jehu arrived in Jezreel Jezebel heard of it So she painted . . . her eyes adorned her head and looked down from a window
verses.literalPt: Depois Jeú veio a Jizreel, o que ouvindo Jezabel, pintou-se em volta dos olhos, enfeitou a sua cabeça, e olhou pela janela.

verses.original: וְיֵה֖וּא בָּ֣א בַשָּׁ֑עַר וַתֹּ֣אמֶר הֲשָׁל֔וֹם זִמְרִ֖י הֹרֵ֥ג אֲדֹנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yê·hū bā ḇaš·šā·‘ar wat·tō·mer hă·šā·lō·wm zim·rî hō·rêḡ ’ă·ḏō·nāw
verses.literal: And as Jehu entered the gate she asked Have you come in peace O Zimri murderer of your master
verses.literalPt: E, entrando Jeú pelas portas, disse ela: Teve paz Zinri, que matou a seu SENHOR?

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֤א פָנָיו֙ אֶל־ הַ֣חַלּ֔וֹן וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מִ֥י אִתִּ֖י מִ֑י וַיַּשְׁקִ֣יפוּ אֵלָ֔יו שְׁנַ֥יִם שְׁלֹשָׁ֖ה סָרִיסִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·śā p̄ā·nāw ’el- ha·ḥal·lō·wn way·yō·mer mî ’it·tî mî way·yaš·qî·p̄ū ’ê·lāw šə·na·yim šə·lō·šāh sā·rî·sîm
verses.literal: He looked up . . . at the window and called out Who is on my side Who And two or three eunuchs looked down at him
verses.literalPt: E levantou ele o rosto para a janela e disse: Quem é comigo? quem? E dois ou três eunucos olharam para ele.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר שִׁמְטֻהוּ וַֽיִּשְׁמְט֑וּהָ וַיִּ֨ז מִדָּמָ֧הּ אֶל־ הַקִּ֛יר וְאֶל־ הַסּוּסִ֖ים וַֽיִּרְמְסֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šim·ṭu·hū way·yiš·mə·ṭū·hā way·yiz mid·dā·māh ’el- haq·qîr wə·’el- has·sū·sîm way·yir·mə·sen·nāh
verses.literal: Throw her down yelled Jehu So they threw her down and her blood splattered on the wall and on the horses as they trampled her underfoot
verses.literalPt: Então disse ele: Lançai-a daí abaixo. E lançaram-na abaixo; e foram salpicados com o seu sangue a parede e os cavalos, e Jeú a atropelou.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֖א וַיֹּ֣אכַל וַיֵּ֑שְׁתְּ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר פִּקְדוּ־ נָ֞א אֶת־ הָאֲרוּרָ֤ה הַזֹּאת֙ וְקִבְר֔וּהָ כִּ֥י בַת־ מֶ֖לֶךְ הִֽיא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō way·yō·ḵal way·yê·šət way·yō·mer piq·ḏū- nā ’eṯ- hā·’ă·rū·rāh haz·zōṯ wə·qiḇ·rū·hā kî ḇaṯ- me·leḵ hî
verses.literal: Then Jehu went in and ate and drank Take care of . . . this cursed woman he said and bury her for she was the daughter of a king
verses.literalPt: Entrando ele e havendo comido e bebido, disse: Olhai por aquela maldita, e sepultai-a, porque é filha de rei.

verses.original: וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ לְקָבְרָ֑הּ וְלֹא־ מָ֣צְאוּ בָ֗הּ כִּ֧י אִם־ הַגֻּלְגֹּ֛לֶת וְהָרַגְלַ֖יִם וְכַפּ֥וֹת הַיָּדָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·lə·ḵū lə·qā·ḇə·rāh wə·lō- mā·ṣə·’ū ḇāh kî ’im- hag·gul·gō·leṯ wə·hā·raḡ·la·yim wə·ḵap·pō·wṯ hay·yā·ḏā·yim
verses.literal: But when they went out to bury her they found nothing but . . . her skull her feet and the palms of her hands
verses.literalPt: E foram para a sepultar; porém não acharam dela senão somente a caveira, os pés e as palmas das mãos.

verses.original: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ֮ וַיַּגִּ֣ידוּ לוֹ֒ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֣ה ה֔וּא אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֗ר בְּיַד־ עַבְדּ֛וֹ אֵלִיָּ֥הוּ הַתִּשְׁבִּ֖י לֵאמֹ֑ר בְּחֵ֣לֶק יִזְרְעֶ֔אל יֹאכְל֥וּ הַכְּלָבִ֖ים אֶת־ בְּשַׂ֥ר אִיזָֽבֶל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šu·ḇū way·yag·gî·ḏū lōw way·yō·mer də·ḇar- Yah·weh hū ’ă·šer dib·ber bə·yaḏ- ‘aḇ·dōw ’ê·lî·yā·hū hat·tiš·bî lê·mōr bə·ḥê·leq yiz·rə·‘el yō·ḵə·lū hak·kə·lā·ḇîm ’eṯ- bə·śar ’î·zā·ḇel
verses.literal: So they went back and told Jehu who replied This is the word of the LORD which He spoke through His servant Elijah the Tishbite . . . On the plot of ground at Jezreel the dogs will devour the flesh of Jezebel
verses.literalPt: Então voltaram, e lho fizeram saber; e ele disse: Esta é a palavra do SENHOR, a qual falou pelo ministério de Elias, o tisbita, seu servo, dizendo: No pedaço do campo de Jizreel os cães comerão a carne de Jezabel.

verses.original: וְהָיָת נִבְלַ֣ת אִיזֶ֗בֶל כְּדֹ֛מֶן עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה בְּחֵ֣לֶק יִזְרְעֶ֑אל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ יֹאמְר֖וּ זֹ֥את אִיזָֽבֶל׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hå̄·yå̄ṯ niḇ·laṯ ’î·ze·ḇel kə·ḏō·men ‘al- pə·nê haś·śā·ḏeh bə·ḥê·leq yiz·rə·‘el ’ă·šer lō- yō·mə·rū zōṯ ’î·zā·ḇel
verses.literal: And Jezebel’s body will lie like dung in the field on the plot of ground at Jezreel so that no one can say This is Jezebel
verses.literalPt: E o cadáver de Jezabel será como esterco sobre o campo, na herdade de Jizreel; de modo que não se possa dizer: Esta é Jezabel.
